static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.social_status: 有一个支持性的朋友群体，但因Self-doubt和持续比较而影响与朋友的关系；尚not yet向朋友讨论具体的“not够好”感受
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 能清晰表达并进行Reflection；Low mood、持怀疑态度但愿意尝试；与咨询师配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己not能在徒步中表现出色，因为我not是世界级的徒步者，这导致Self-doubt和not够好的感觉。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent self-doubt和“not够好”感开始影响我对其他爱好和活动的动力，促使我寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 几年前开始将徒步作为爱好，起初感到有趣，但随着在社交媒体上看到他人分享更出色的徒步表现与冒险经历，自己not断进行比较并逐渐加重Self-doubt；尽管尝试设定个人目标提升徒步skill，达成目标后也难以维持自我肯定，这种“not够好”的感觉扩展到其他兴趣与活动并影响与朋友的关系。

core_beliefs: 只有成为最优秀才有价值/享受

special_situations.event: On social media, sees others share more outstanding hiking performances or adventures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是世界级或not是最优秀，就等于not够好、have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves oneself by setting higher personal goals and extra practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都比我强，I am not good enough。

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends, notices the other person performs better in areas such as hiking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如朋友，就会显得失败、not配参与
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Social withdrawal、减少与朋友联系以避免比较
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，和他们在一起让我更显得not够好。

special_situations.event: 达成个人设定的徒步目标后仍然感到not足
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有达到世界级水平才值得肯定，其他进步都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提高标准、negate已有进步的价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些进步not值一提，还是远远not够。

special_situations.event: 想到要去徒步或计划新的爱好时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能成为最优秀，就等于浪费时间、have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低尝试新活动的动力、推迟或放弃
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 既然做not到最好，那就not必要去做。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被视为有价值与优秀
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为not够好、害怕失败与羞耻
defense_goal: 通过坚持“必须成为最优秀”的标准来维持自尊、避免暴露not够好的自我

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的比较者、容易被他人超越的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 更优秀、带有评判的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on challenging the belief 'must become the best' or discussing setting non-comparative, enjoyment-oriented goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者可能将咨询师的探询理解为在negate或削弱自己的标准（移情：将外界的评判感Projection到咨询情境中）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useEmpathy且not评判的语气；先验证其对“标准”的重要性，再以开放式问题引导其具体化体验与成本收益；避免直接对抗，邀请其举例说明在非最佳时的愉悦瞬间。

manifestations: 将活动的意义与是否“世界级/最优秀”紧密绑定，认为“若not是最优秀就是浪费时间”
享受感被表现与比较所吞not，对徒步的本身价值产生怀疑
outcomes: Decreased drive，减少参与新爱好与活动

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“必须/应该成为最优秀”的内在规则来评判自我
将享受与世界级表现绑定，negate非顶尖状态下的积极体验

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自我比较与Self-denial，担心“not够好”而减少参与新活动
在朋友关系中因Self-doubt而Withdrawal、谨慎表达真实感受

positive_force: Has a supportive group of friends，可提供情感支持
Can experience the joy of nature and some pleasure in the hiking activity itself
Willing to try new goal setting and cognitive restructuring (open attitude toward counseling)
negative_force: 非黑即白思维与过度比较主导意义评估
negate积极进步，难以内化自我肯定
Ties worth to external performance / world-class standards; overly relies on external comparison

target_behavior.behavior: 在想到徒步或看到他人徒步分享时出现强烈Self-doubt并显著降低参与动力
antecedent: Sees others sharing hiking adventures or better performances on social media
target_behavior.core_reason: The inner belief is 'only by becoming the very best is there meaning', driven by black-and-white thinking and comparison
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame, relieving the threat of being judged in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: 对徒步的享受减少，整体Decreased drive，进一步影响其他兴趣与活动

target_behavior.behavior: 在与朋友互动中Withdrawal、减少联系
antecedent: 与朋友互动时注意到朋友的表现更好
想到可能被比较或被视为“not够好”
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值过度依赖外部比较与评判，害怕暴露not够好
target_behavior.function: Avoids feeling ashamed and judged, maintaining fragile self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Friendships are affected, reducing supportive interactions and positive experiences
